svg.title: Arwad, Phase 2 results
svg.desc: Times faster than R: 43.7× vs the lm() loop most researchers write; 7.4× vs the same algorithm in plain R: compilation alone; 10.8× vs the glm() loop most researchers write; 12.3× vs the same algorithm in plain R: compilation alone; 5.1× 10,000 resamples, vs seminr::bootstrap_model() on 4 cores; 10.7× 1,000 resamples, vs the same algorithm in plain R. Results bit-identical to R and seminr.

svg.text: The same answers as R, bit for bit, from native code

text.font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Times faster on one laptop core (Intel i7-7600U), same seed for every contender. Green: against the code researchers use today.

text.font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blue: against the same algorithm run by GNU R, which is what compilation alone adds.
